weaknesses.title: CLAMPWHERE equality match only — no rate>HI predicate without status
weaknesses.detail: Cannot clamp only workers already over budget without a status/tag field. Agents must mark hot first or clamp entire class.
weaknesses.repro: want clamp rate>100 only; need status=hot marker

weaknesses.title: No per-pool LO/HI — one bound for all matching status
weaknesses.detail: api and batch hot workers share same clamp range; multi-pool budgets need multiple CLAMPWHERE or SETFWHERE glue.
weaknesses.repro: hot api cap 100 batch cap 50 — one clamp hits both

weaknesses.title: UNIQUWHERE first-seen order not sorted; no count per unique
weaknesses.detail: Pool inventory is unordered first-seen; frequency needs FREQWHERE separately (and *WHERE clobber risk from iter 130).

weaknesses.title: Empty MAXWHERE → 0 like true zero rate
weaknesses.detail: Admit must COUNTWHERE N>0; empty status would admit under BUDGET≥0 without gate.

weaknesses.title: LO>HI auto-swap is silent — no warn
weaknesses.detail: LO=50 HI=20 becomes [20,50] via CLAMPWHERE_LO/HI; agent mis-order bounds without hard error.
weaknesses.repro: META lo 20 hi 50 after LO=50 HI=20

weaknesses.title: Non-numeric REQUIRE/LO/HI softens
weaknesses.detail: REQUIRE=abc → soft; bad LO keeps default.
